title: Adopt the lightx2v v1.0 4-step turbo LoRA on H3, and put comfy kitchen attention on the turbo path only
description: Bench-measured 2026-08-30: the v1.0 4-step resized LoRA beats the shipped v0.1 on quality, and ModelAttentionBackend 'comfy kitchen attention' gains speed AND looks cleaner on the turbo path - but degrades quality on the 25-step path, so it is wired to the turbo branch only. 8-step v1.0 tested and rejected: same quality, more time. Attention outcome feeds MPI-605.
